noun_definition: Chat refers to the messaging interface where users can compose and send messages, which in this context is expected to display an expand button when the message composer contains multiple new lines.
Expand button refers to a user interface element that should appear above the "+" button in the chat composer when the composer contains three or more new lines.
composer refers to the text input area in the chat where users can type their messages, which in this case is being tested for its behavior when it contains only new lines.
New line refers to a blank line created in the chat composer by pressing the Enter key without adding any text, which in this Issue context affects the visibility of the expand button.
